Virginia Retirement Systems Et Al Has Upped Its Public Storage (PSA) Position by $3.85 Million as Valuation Declined
April 30, 2018 - By Adrian Erickson
Virginia Retirement Systems Et Al increased its stake in Public Storage (PSA) by 12.29% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Virginia Retirement Systems Et Al bought 18,500 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.82% with the market. The institutional investor held 169,054 shares of the real estate investment trusts company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $35.33 million, up from 150,554 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Virginia Retirement Systems Et Al who had been investing in Public Storage for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $35.38B market cap company. The stock increased 0.36% or $0.72 during the last trading session, reaching $203.17. About 205,677 shares traded. Public Storage (NYSE:PSA) has declined 10.33% since April 30, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 21.88% the S&P500.
Virginia Retirement Systems Et Al, which manages about $8.47 billion US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in Extra Space Storage Inc (NYSE:EXR) by 39,700 shares to 110,900 shares, valued at $9.70M in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also reduced its holding in Ross Stores Inc (NASDAQ:ROST) by 47,600 shares in the quarter, leaving it with 242,200 shares, and cut its stake in Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL). Public Storage (NYSE:PSA) Ratings Coverage
Among 10 analysts covering Public Storage ( NYSE:PSA ), 0 have Buy rating, 4 Sell and 6 Hold. Therefore 0 are positive. Public Storage had 16 analyst reports since November 15, 2017 according to SRatingsIntel. Morgan Stanley downgraded the shares of PSA in report on Wednesday, December 13 to “Sell” rating. The rating was upgraded by Bank of America to “Neutral” on Tuesday, February 27. As per Thursday, March 15, the company rating was maintained by KeyBanc Capital Markets. The rating was maintained by Robert W. Baird on Thursday, March 8 with “Sell”. The stock of Public Storage (NYSE:PSA) has “Sell” rating given on Wednesday, November 15 by KeyBanc Capital Markets. On Monday, March 5 the stock rating was upgraded by Evercore to “In-Line”. The rating was maintained by Jefferies on Wednesday, April 25 with “Hold”. BMO Capital Markets maintained the shares of PSA in report on Tuesday, January 9 with “Sell” rating. The firm earned “Underperform” rating on Monday, December 4 by Bank of America. On Monday, November 27 the stock rating was maintained by Jefferies with “Hold”.
